title: The Postcard of the Crescent Cove
author: Elodie Okafor
blurb: Rosalind Blackwood, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
